# Issue #41: `slugify` produces double hyphens and trailing hyphens

`slugify("Hello,  World!")` returns `"hello--world-"` but should return `"hello-world"`.
Also `slugify("--a--b--")` should give `"a-b"`.

The current implementation of `slugify` converts the text to lowercase and replaces any non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens. It doesn't handle multiple hyphens or leading/trailing hyphens.

I need to add steps to:
1. Replace multiple hyphens with a single hyphen.
2. Remove leading and trailing hyphens.

I will modify lines 7 and 8.

- After `text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "-", text)`, add a line to replace multiple hyphens with a single hyphen: `text = re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)`.
- Then, add a line to remove leading and trailing hyphens: `text = text.strip("-")`.

I have modified the `textkit/slug.py` file to address the issues of double hyphens and trailing hyphens.
The changes involve adding two new lines after the initial hyphen replacement:
1. `text = re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)`: This replaces one or more consecutive hyphens with a single hyphen.
2. `text = text.strip("-")`: This removes any hyphens from the beginning or end of the string.
